# content-card API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Titled content and explicit caller actions composed with native Fluent Card interaction.

## ContentCard

Group a content summary with explicit caller-owned actions and native Card interaction.
Literal strings retain their text; compose FormattedText explicitly for Markdown.
Requires the host Fluent theme and Griffel renderer; no SPFx provider is required.
Root ref identifies the native div. Disabled preserves child disabled flags; native Card may block pointer input with its overlay.

### Imports

```ts
import { ContentCard } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { ContentCard } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { ContentCard } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/content-card';
```

### Use when

- A titled summary needs native Card interactions, caller content and explicit header/footer actions.

### Avoid when

- Use PreviewCard when the layout requires a preview-media region.

### Examples

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { ContentCard } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<ContentCard title="Workspace" footer="Updated today" actions={<button>Open</button>}>Three members</ContentCard>
```

### Signatures

```ts
(props: ContentCardProps & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>): ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | null
```

#### Parameters

- `props`: Native Fluent Card behavior, required title and optional summary/body/action slots.

#### Returns

A native div Card with a heading, optional body and explicit footer regions.

## ContentCardProps

Titled content using native Card interaction and fixed-tag Fluent content slots.
Strings are literal. Objects introduce inner containers; their refs never replace owned shells.
Callbacks run during rendering and must forward composed props. JSX remains caller-owned.
Native focus, selection, size, checkbox, floatingAction, events and root ref are preserved.
Uses the host Fluent theme/Griffel renderer without an SPFx provider. Optional regions
are omitted for absent/empty shorthand; explicit object/callback slots request their containers.

### Imports (4)

```ts
import type { ContentCardProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { ContentCardProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { ContentCardProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/content-card';
```

### Examples (4)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { ContentCard } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<ContentCard title="Workspace" actions={<button>Open</button>}>Three members</ContentCard>
```

### Type (3)

```ts
interface ContentCardProps extends Omit<CardProps, "title" | "dangerouslySetInnerHTML" | "children" | "as" | "appearance" | "orientation">
```

### Members (3)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ContentCardProps.actions` | `ContentSlot<"div">` | Optional | — | Independent footer div slot for explicit caller controls; buttons own their props.<br>When omitted, this actions region is absent. |
| `ContentCardProps.appearance` | `ContentCardAppearance \| undefined` | Optional | 'filled' | Native Fluent appearance; when omitted, defaults to filled. Size defaults to medium. |
| `ContentCardProps.children` | `ReactNode` | Optional | — | Caller-owned body; strings remain literal and controls retain identity.<br>When omitted, no child content is added. |
| `ContentCardProps.dangerouslySetInnerHTML` | `never` | Forbidden | — | Raw HTML is unsupported; provide React children or safe content slots.<br>Must be omitted or undefined in this branch. |
| `ContentCardProps.description` | `ContentSlot<"div">` | Optional | — | Optional supporting div slot. Literal strings, including object children, have a<br>two-line limit; JSX/callbacks own presentation. When omitted, leaves no description region. |
| `ContentCardProps.footer` | `ContentSlot<"div">` | Optional | — | Supplemental footer div slot; does not imply a timestamp or navigation.<br>When omitted, this footer region is absent. |
| `ContentCardProps.headerActions` | `ContentSlot<"div">` | Optional | — | Header div slot for explicit caller controls, independent of footer actions.<br>When omitted, this headerActions region is absent. |
| `ContentCardProps.headingLevel` | `ContentCardHeadingLevel \| undefined` | Optional | 3 | Owned heading tag h1–h6; when omitted, defaults to h3. |
| `ContentCardProps.icon` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Optional | — | Decorative header span slot, hidden from assistive technology.<br>When omitted, this icon region is absent. |
| `ContentCardProps.title` | ``(string \| number \| Iterable<any> \| (Omit<{ as?: "span" \| undefined; } & Omit<Pick<DetailedHTMLProps<HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, HTMLSpanElement>, "key" \| keyof HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>> & { ref?: ((instance: HTMLSpanElement \| null) => void) \| RefObject<HTMLSpanElement> \| null \| undefined; }, "children"> & { children?: ReactNode \| SlotRenderFunction<Pick<DetailedHTMLProps<HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, HTMLSpanElement>, "key" \| keyof HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>> & { ref?: ((instance: HTMLSpanElement \| null) => void) \| RefObject<HTMLSpanElement> \| null \| undefined; }>; }, "dangerouslySetInnerHTML"> & { dangerouslySetInnerHTML?: undefined; call?: undefined; } & {}) \| (Omit<{ as?: "span" \| undefined; } & Omit<Pick<DetailedHTMLProps<HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, HTMLSpanElement>, "key" \| keyof HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>> & { ref?: ((instance: HTMLSpanElement \| null) => void) \| RefObject<HTMLSpanElement> \| null \| undefined; }, "children"> & { children?: ReactNode \| SlotRenderFunction<Pick<DetailedHTMLProps<HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, HTMLSpanElement>, "key" \| keyof HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>> & { ref?: ((instance: HTMLSpanElement \| null) => void) \| RefObject<HTMLSpanElement> \| null \| undefined; }>; }, "dangerouslySetInnerHTML"> & { dangerouslySetInnerHTML?: undefined; call?: undefined; } & {} & { [x: `data-${string}`]: string \| number \| boolean \| undefined; })) & (string \| number \| object)`` | Required | — | Required meaningful phrasing content inside the owned heading; fixed inner span.<br>No nested headings.
